params.aethToken_: AethToken contract (must grant this contract BURNER_ROLE).
params.itemRegistry_: ItemRegistry contract (must grant this contract MINTER_ROLE                       and BURNER_ROLE).

craft(uint256).details: CEI order:   CHECKS   - recipe exists & active, player holds all ingredients and AETH allowance.   EFFECTS  - (none: no CraftingEngine state changes mid-function).   INTERACTIONS - burn ingredients, charge AETH, mint output. ReentrancyGuard protects against ERC-1155 reentrancy via onERC1155Received.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

previewAethCost(uint256).details: Useful for frontend approval flow: call this, then approve, then craft.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setRecipeCost(uint256,uint256).details: Callable via a governance proposal routed through the Timelock.

craft(uint256).notice: Craft an item using a recipe.

getRecipe(uint256).notice: Returns the full Recipe struct for a given recipeId.

previewAethCost(uint256).notice: Preview how much AETH a craft will cost at the current oracle price.

removeRecipe(uint256).notice: Disable a recipe (soft-delete; recipeId is never reused).

setRecipeCost(uint256,uint256).notice: Update the USD cost of an existing active recipe.

treasury().notice: Address that receives the treasury fee portion of every craft.

treasuryFeeBps().notice: Fee taken by the treasury from each craft's AETH cost, in bps.
